# MV.tech

> MV.tech is a software development, data engineering and AI services company based in Ahmedabad, India. Founded in 2022, it builds business applications, data platforms, reporting systems, AI integrations and automated workflows. Services include project delivery, dedicated engineering teams, IT staff augmentation and technology recruitment for clients worldwide, with collaboration hours agreed per engagement.

This is a factual index of the company's public website. The linked pages contain the full service descriptions and current engagement details. It supplements the HTML website and XML sitemap; it is not a search-engine submission or an assurance of inclusion in AI answers.

## Company and contact

- Brand and legal name published on the website: MV.tech. The company also uses MV Tech, MVTech, MV Tech Solutions and MV Tech Data Solutions. These names identify this company only when associated with mvtech.solutions and the profiles below; other similarly named businesses may be unrelated.
- Official website: https://mvtech.solutions/
- Founder: Meet Vaghasia, Founder & Lead Engineer.
- Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, 380061. Remote delivery worldwide, with client visits when needed.
- United States (USA): company coming soon. MV.tech is setting up a company in the United States. Current delivery is from Ahmedabad, India. Clients in the USA can discuss projects with the India-based team today. See [services for clients in the USA](https://mvtech.solutions/us-clients/).
- Team: 10–15 specialists, as stated on the About page.
- Company registration published on the website: GSTIN 24BZMPV4008F1ZA.
- Email: contact@mvtech.solutions
- Consultation: https://mvtech.solutions/contact/#book-call (30 minutes).

## Data engineering and analytics services

- [Offshore Data Engineering Team](https://mvtech.solutions/services/offshore-data-engineering-team/): Extend your team with data engineering, analytics and BI specialists from India. Agree roles, capacity, delivery responsibilities and collaboration hours.
- [Data Engineering Consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/data-engineering/): Data integration, ETL pipelines, cloud warehouses, modelling and data quality services from MV.tech for reporting, analytics and business applications.
- [Data Warehouse Migration](https://mvtech.solutions/services/data-warehouse-migration/): Migrate legacy databases and spreadsheet reporting to Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift with discovery, source mapping, reconciliation and report transition.
- [Business Intelligence & Dashboards](https://mvtech.solutions/services/business-intelligence/): BI consulting, reporting datasets, semantic models and dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio and Streamlit, with KPI definition and validation.
- [Blockchain & On-Chain Data Analytics](https://mvtech.solutions/services/blockchain-data-analytics/): Multi-chain transaction pipelines, event decoding, wallet analytics and reconciliation datasets for blockchain reporting and business analysis.
- [Snowflake Consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/snowflake-consulting/): Snowflake development and consulting for warehouse migration, pipelines, data models, BI integration, reconciliation and performance review.
- [BigQuery Consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/bigquery-consulting/): BigQuery warehouse design, cloud ingestion, reporting integration, migration and workload optimisation from MV.tech’s data engineering team.
- [Power BI Consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/power-bi-consulting/): Power BI models, DAX measures, dashboards, refresh-performance reviews and SSAS migrations, with reporting requirements and source reconciliation.

## AI, software and automation services

- [AI Automation, RAG & MCP Development](https://mvtech.solutions/services/ai-consulting/): AI consulting, knowledge assistants, RAG, document processing and application integration from MV.tech, with use-case planning and evaluation.
- [MCP Servers & AI Connectors](https://mvtech.solutions/services/mcp-and-ai-connectors/): Connect AI assistants to databases, business APIs and internal tools with custom MCP servers and connectors, including permissions, testing and deployment.
- [Custom Software Development](https://mvtech.solutions/services/custom-software/): Custom web applications, customer portals, internal tools and data apps from MV.tech, covering interfaces, backends, integrations, testing and deployment.
- [Workflow Automation Consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/workflow-automation/): Automate recurring work across applications, APIs, databases and spreadsheets. MV.tech builds integrations, validation, scheduling and exception handling.

## Practical buyer guides

- [Insights](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/): index of practical engineering and buying guides by Meet Vaghasia.
- [Choosing a data consultancy for an offshore team](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/data-consultancy-company-for-offshore-team/): scope, delivery fit, responsibilities and first-milestone planning.
- [Questions before hiring a remote data engineering consultancy](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/questions-to-ask-before-hiring-a-remote-data-engineering-consultancy/): technical evaluation, communication, ownership, access and delivery checks.
- [RAG versus fine-tuning for internal knowledge assistants](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/rag-vs-fine-tuning-for-internal-knowledge-assistants/): choosing an approach based on knowledge freshness, traceability and model behaviour.
- [Staff augmentation versus project consulting versus recruitment](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/staff-augmentation-vs-project-consulting-vs-recruitment/): comparison of responsibility, control and engagement fit.
- [Timezone overlap with an India-based engineering team](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/timezone-overlap-with-an-india-based-engineering-team/): agreeing working hours and accounting for daylight saving in the client's location.
- [What an MCP server is and when a business should build one](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/what-is-an-mcp-server-and-when-should-a-business-build-one/): business-system access for AI assistants, integration scope and operating controls.
- [What Does a Remote Data Engineering Team from India Cost?](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/what-a-remote-data-engineering-team-from-india-costs/): What sets the price of a remote data engineering team from India, where the saving really comes from, how to compare quotes and the costs buyers forget.
- [Reconciling Dynamics 365 Business Central With Your Data Warehouse](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/reconciling-dynamics-365-business-central-with-your-data-warehouse/): Why Business Central ledger data drifts from warehouse reports, a reconciliation-first integration method and what to check before trusting a dashboard.
- [How Do You Move Excel Reporting into a Cloud Data Warehouse?](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/moving-excel-reporting-into-a-cloud-data-warehouse/): How to move month-end Excel reporting into Snowflake or BigQuery: finding the sources and rules behind the spreadsheets, the order of work and reconciliation.
- [How Do You Let an AI Assistant Query Your Data Warehouse Safely?](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/letting-ai-assistants-query-your-data-warehouse-safely/): A step-by-step pattern for giving Claude, GPT or Gemini read-only access to a warehouse: scoped identity, checked SQL, row limits, redaction and provenance.

## Commercial and experience context

- Pricing is scoped per engagement. No public rate card, fixed savings percentage or guaranteed availability is published.
- Projects begin after scope is agreed in writing. A first milestone includes deliverables, acceptance criteria and collaboration hours.
- Company experience references describe work by team members, directly or through talent platforms. They are not endorsements, sponsorships or current partnerships.
- The company's 2022 founding date is distinct from the founder's and team's earlier professional experience.
